title: Duke Nukem: Zero Hour (clean room)
info_html:
Controls: arrow keys = stick (move / turn) · A = Z (fire) · D = A · S = B · E = R · J/K/I/L = C buttons · Enter = Start · gamepads work too (remap under the ` menu). On phones and tablets a touch pad appears. If you hear nothing, tap the page once.

Built from the DukeNukemZeroHour decomp (USA) compiled with the original KMC GCC 2.7.2. Textures, sprites, fonts, pictures and sound samples are regenerated from coarse facts (size, format, a 4x4 colour grid, a 2-bit alpha outline; sample length, loops and a spectral outline) — no original pixels or samples are included. Level geometry, music note data, text and game code come from the decomp. Voices are placeholders. Runs on N64Wasm (MIT). Source: andrewnakas/dukezh-cleanroom.
